1) the LSTM recurrent neural networks can be used to model acoustic features in a hybrid HSM setup, 2) state prediction networks outperform phoneme prediction networks, and 3) LSTM recurrent neural networks outperform GMM-HMM models for the task of speech recognition in a reverberation and noisy environment.
LSTM networks perform well for state prediction in hybrid HMM setups and outperform GMM-HMMs and phoneme prediction networks in a multi-stream setup.

LSTM networks are a promising approach for robust speech recognition and that the proposed LSTM-based hybrid HMM system performs better than a GMM-HMM system with the same acoustic modelling technique.
